name: web-publish
description: Plan, build, check and publish a business website grounded in the business itself: claim-graded copy, a page map, a per-project DESIGN.md, a working hero slice, role-assigned media, a media metadata audit, a motion plan by kind, mobile QA with evidence grades, and a publish step with a local-folder default. Two human approvals (plan, release); seven wait points also pause the run until you or your agent produce that stage's output and approve to re-check it.
